[[Koren's Hornbow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] dropped by [[Koren Wildrunner]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Drakkar Lake]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30
